scope: Chat provider response handling; no credential or deployment changes

sources.applied: Require STOP before treating non-streaming candidate text as a complete answer; exclude thought parts; honor provider blocks.
Keep existing transient-status fallbacks; do not retry provider 400/401/403/404 errors. Return sanitized errors and record provider status without raw details.
Do not promise a quota failure will clear in a few minutes.

findings: Incomplete or blocked candidate text could be reported as a successful answer.
Answers longer than the saved-message limit were silently clipped.
Thought text could be included in the displayed answer.
Provider messages could expose internal diagnostic or account details.
Provider timeouts and interrupted body reads lost their cause.

limitations: Mocked provider tests establish error handling, not live provider access or answer accuracy.
A successful STOP response can still contain incorrect claims; evidence-quality evaluation remains necessary.
The real two-photo and three-photo benchmark still needs authorized authenticated Preview access.
No iPad hardware test or returning-customer browser session test was completed in this check.
